author.pt-BR: Companheiros de São Francisco (Espelho da perfeição)

description.la: Speculum perfectionis status fratris Minoris, scilicet beati Francisci, in centum viginti quattuor capitibus (redactio anni 1318).
description.en-US: The Mirror of Perfection of the state of a Friar Minor: memories of St. Francis gathered from the writings of his companions, above all Brother Leo, and compiled in 1318 in 124 chapters under thirteen heads (poverty, charity, humility, zeal for the Rule, prayer, prophecy, his love of creatures, his death). Latin in Sabatier's numbering; English of Robert Steele (Everyman, 1910).
description.pt-BR: O Espelho da perfeição do estado do frade menor: memórias de São Francisco recolhidas dos escritos de seus companheiros, sobretudo frei Leão, compiladas em 1318 em 124 capítulos.

sources.edition: Speculum perfectionis, web transcription of franciscanos.net (Fuentes franciscanas), in the numbering of Sabatier's edition (Paris 1898); local mirror in research/sourcing/francis-of-assisi/mirror-franciscanos-net/.
sources.description: Clean transcription with verse numbers (kept as bold numbers) and the transcription's 'cfr.' Scripture references. The bracketed interpolation in chapter LXXI is kept as printed there.
sources.tierEvidence: Medieval text in the numbering of the 1898 edition.

sources.edition: The Little Flowers, The Mirror of Perfection, and St. Bonaventure's Life of St. Francis (London: J. M. Dent, Everyman's Library, 1910), the Mirror translated by Robert Steele.
sources.description: Archive.org OCR read from the word-coordinate file and cleaned by script, not proofread; running heads and page numbers dropped.
